dialog.english: There's just sand in my eye!
dialog.translation: Es solo arena en el ojo!

dialog.english: Let's plaaaaaaaay!
Huh?!
I've got a riddle for you!
Pinocchimon!
...What kind of riddle?
What is it that I'm missing?
dialog.translation: Qué es lo que me falta?

dialog.english: Missing...?
Answer me now, or I'll kill you.

I don't know what you're talking
about!
dialog.translation:
No sé de qué
me hablas!

dialog.english:
So you won't answer me. Okay, how
about I kill you now?
dialog.translation:
Así que no respondes. Vale,
te mato ya, entonces?

dialog.english: Gomamon!
Aaaaaaaaaaaagh!
Aaaaaaaaaaaagh!
Aaaaaaaaaaaagh!
Who are you?!

Ughighi... you don't just say "who
are you" to a superstar!
dialog.translation:
Ughighi... no se le dice "quién
eres" a una superestrella!

dialog.english: You're...

It's been a while, Chosen
Children.

Etemon's in the past! Now, I'm the
reborn MetalEtemon!
dialog.translation:
Etemon es pasado! Ahora soy
MetalEtemon renacido!

dialog.english:
You're supposed to be dead! What
are you doing here?
dialog.translation:
Se supone que estabas muerto!
Qué haces aquí?

dialog.english: Good of you to ask.

It's a stoooooory ~ that makes
both the listener and the
storyteller cryyyyyy ~
dialog.translation:
Es una historiaaaa ~ que hace
llorar a quien cuenta y a quien
escuchaaaa ~

dialog.english: S-Shut up!

After I was sucked into the black
hole ~ I survived in a hellish
dark world ~
dialog.translation:
Tras caer al agujero negro ~
sobreviví en un mundo
oscuro e infernal ~

dialog.english:
With only the purpose ~ to be
reborn ~ and take revenge on the
Chosen Children ~
dialog.translation:
Con un único propósito ~
renacer ~ y vengarme de los
Niños Elegidos ~

dialog.english: It's finally over...
There's still more, kiddo.

Did you just call me a kid?! Don't
call me a kid!
dialog.translation:
Me has llamado chaval?! No me
llames chaval!

dialog.english: How dare you!
Now's our chance to run for it!
Good idea...
Whaaaaaaaaaat?!

Hahahaha! Now, time for the
children...
dialog.translation:
Jajajaja! Ahora, toca a
los niños...

dialog.english: Huh? They're gone...
What'd you say?! Ghiiiii!

Whew... the fact that those two
were fighting saved us...
dialog.translation:
Uf... que esos dos se
pelearan nos salvó...

dialog.english:
Seems like I really can't rely on
you guys after all. I'll help you
out.
dialog.translation:
Está claro que no puedo fiarme
de vosotros. Os voy a ayudar.

dialog.english:
Feels bad to help *you* guys out,
though.
Thanks, but how are your injuries?
That's not an issue!

Hey, Ogremon...why are you and
Leomon always fighting?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Ogremon...por qué siempre
peleas con Leomon?

dialog.english:
Why I'm always fighting with
Leomon?
dialog.translation:
Que por qué peleo tanto
con Leomon?

dialog.english:
Yeah, I... want to know what's the
meaning behind you two always
fighting.
dialog.translation:
Sí, quiero saber... qué
significa que siempre
estéis peleando.

dialog.english:
I dunno about complicated things
like meaning. Leomon's my eternal
rival.
dialog.translation:
Paso de cosas complicadas
como el significado. Leomon es
mi rival eterno.

dialog.english:
So if one of you wins, what
happens next?
dialog.translation:
Y si uno de los dos gana,
qué pasa luego?

dialog.english:
Then the winner wil be able to say
"I did it!"...
dialog.translation:
Pues el ganador podrá decir
"Lo logré!"...

dialog.english: And then...?
Whaddya mean, "and then"...?!

Then you won't have a rival
anymore.

Don't gimme that! Defeating Leomon
is my only reason for living!
dialog.translation:
No me vengas con esas! Vencer
a Leomon es mi motivo
de vida!

dialog.english: If Leomon weren't here, I'd...
Logically, isn't that a paradox?

Shut up! I'll think harder about
it once I actually defeat him!
dialog.translation:
Cállate! Lo pensaré mejor
cuando lo derrote de una vez!

dialog.english:
That's the only conclusion he can
come up with...
dialog.translation:
Es la única conclusión
a la que llega...

dialog.english: W-Who's that?!
An enemy? Or a friend?
Okay... it's my turn!
No, wait! Calm down!
Huh? That voice...
Could it be...

Yes, it's me, Leomon. I've
obtained the power of evolution.
dialog.translation:
Sí, soy yo, Leomon. He obtenido
el poder de evolucionar.

dialog.english: Hey, you!

We'll talk later. I'll guide you
to a safe place, so come this way!
dialog.translation:
Ya hablaremos. Os llevaré a un
lugar seguro, seguidme!

dialog.english:
Hey, this is... This is the
restaurant where Matt and I had
to work!
dialog.translation:
Oye, esto es... El
restaurante donde Matt y yo
tuvimos que trabajar!

dialog.english:
But something's wrong! I'm pretty
sure it was next to a lake...
dialog.translation:
Pero algo no cuadra! Juraría
que estaba junto a un lago...

dialog.english:
All the locations around here have
changed...
dialog.translation:
Todo el paisaje de aquí
ha cambiado...

dialog.english:
Let's hide here for the time
being.

Chosen Children... it's been a
while.

Leomon, how were you able to
evolve?

Well... it seems I've been able to
evolve ever since I was bathed in
the light of your Digivices.
dialog.translation:
Bueno... parece que puedo
evolucionar desde que me iluminó
la luz de vuestros Digivices.

dialog.english:
But I quickly return to my usual
form... I still can't control it
very well.
dialog.translation:
Pero vuelvo enseguida a mi
forma normal... aún no lo
controlo bien.

dialog.english:
Kh! How boring! It's all about
you! Leomon, fight me!
dialog.translation:
Kh! Qué aburrido! Todo es
sobre ti! Pelea conmigo!

dialog.english:
Heal from those wounds first. I'll
fight you then.
dialog.translation:
Cura antes esas heridas.
Luego lucharé contigo.

dialog.english: Gh!
Who's there? Come out!
Eeeeee! Help us, tama!

Please leave us with at least our
lives, ribbit!
dialog.translation:
Por favor, dejadnos al menos
con vida, croac!

dialog.english: Oh! It's you!
Gekomon and Otamamon!

Huh? Ah! It's the princess,
ribbit!
dialog.translation:
Eh? Ah! Es la princesa,
croac!

dialog.english:
Why are you hiding here? What
happened to your castle?
dialog.translation:
Por qué os escondéis?
Qué pasó con vuestro castillo?

dialog.english:
The Dark Masters made it collapse,
ribbit...
dialog.translation:
Los Amos Oscuros lo derrumbaron,
croac...

dialog.english:
We were attacked by the Dark
Masters, and we escaped with our
lives...
dialog.translation:
Nos atacaron los Amos Oscuros
y escapamos con vida...

dialog.english: How awful...

We can't let them keep doing as
they please.
dialog.translation:
No podemos dejarles hacer
lo que quieran.

dialog.english:
We must defeat the Dark Masters
and extinguish the dark forces
from this world.
dialog.translation:
Debemos vencer a los Amos
Oscuros y acabar con la
oscuridad de este mundo.

dialog.english:
We need your power, Chosen
Children!

We should have just fought the
Dark Masters from the very
beginning...
dialog.translation:
Deberíamos haber luchado contra
los Amos Oscuros desde el
principio...

dialog.english:
If you'd fought the Dark Masters
just like that, you'd be dead
before you knew it!
dialog.translation:
Si hubierais luchado contra
ellos así sin más, ya
estaríais muertos!

dialog.english:
But then all those Digimon
wouldn't have died for us!
dialog.translation:
Pero esos Digimon no habrían
muerto por nosotros!

dialog.english: Mimi!

Having everyone start off at File
Island was most likely a trial for
you.
dialog.translation:
Que empezarais todos en
Isla File fue sin duda
una prueba para vosotros.

dialog.english:
But now that you've overcome that
trial, you've grown to be able to 
fight the Dark Masters.
dialog.translation:
Pero al superar esa prueba,
ya podéis luchar contra
los Amos Oscuros.

dialog.english:
Now is the time to defeat the Dark
Masters!
dialog.translation:
Ahora toca vencer a los
Amos Oscuros!

dialog.english:
But right now, all the Chosen
Children are kind of...
separated...
dialog.translation:
Pero ahora mismo, los Niños
Elegidos están un poco...
separados...

dialog.english: Separated?

We're sort of in the middle of
another trial right now...
dialog.translation:
Estamos en medio de otra
prueba ahora mismo...

dialog.english: Ah! MetalEtemon's here!
What?!

Ghiiii! Finally found you! I'll
get a good heaping of revenge on
yoooou!
dialog.translation:
Ghiiii! Por fin os encuentro!
Me voy a vengar bien de
vosotroooos!

dialog.english: Leave him to me. Run, all of you!
Leomon, stop!

SaberLeomon's right. Right now, we
have to get out of here!
dialog.translation:
SaberLeomon tiene razón. Hay
que salir de aquí ya!

dialog.english:
Wait! I'm the only one allowed to
defeat Leomon!
dialog.translation:
Espera! Solo yo puedo
derrotar a Leomon!

dialog.english: Whaaaaat?

Stop, Ogremon! You're no match for
him!
dialog.translation:
Para, Ogremon! No estás a su
altura!

dialog.english:
Shut up! You're always trying to
look cool!
No! Stop fighting!

Shaddup! No need to hurry, I'll
send you to the afterlife all at
once!
dialog.translation:
Callaos! No hay prisa, os
mando al otro mundo a los
dos de una vez!

dialog.english: Are you okay, SaberLeomon?!

Gh... Don't worry about me... Now,
get out of here...
dialog.translation:
Gh... No os preocupéis por
mí... Marchaos ya...

dialog.english: Evolve to Zudomon!
It's pointless, it's pointless!

My Chrome Digizoid body is fully
coated with metal!
dialog.translation:
Mi cuerpo de Chrome Digizoid
está blindado del todo

dialog.english:
Okay, then how about this? Hammer
Boomerang!
dialog.translation:
Vale, pues prueba esto!
Bumerán Martillo!

dialog.english:
Are you stupid? No matter what you
do, you can't...
dialog.translation:
Eres tonto? Hagas lo que
hagas, no puedes...

dialog.english: Aaaaah! You damaged my body!

Joke's on you! My Thor's Hammer is
also made of Chrome Digizoid!
dialog.translation:
Te equivocas! Mi Martillo de
Thor también es Chrome
Digizoid!

dialog.english: Whaaaaaaaat?!
Now's our chance!

This...can't ~ be ~
happeniiiiiing!!
We did it!
Leomon!
Leomon! You're looking really bad!

Don't be sad... I will be reborn
in the Village of Beginnings.
dialog.translation:
No estéis tristes... Renaceré
en la Aldea del Comienzo.

dialog.english:
Sorry, Ogremon... we'll have to
wait until then... to settle...
our fight...
dialog.translation:
Perdona, Ogremon... tendremos
que esperar para acabar...
nuestra pelea...

dialog.english: Leomon?!
Nooooooooo!!
No...

Mimi, let's go to the Village of
Beginnings!
dialog.translation:
Mimi, vamos a la Aldea del
Comienzo!

dialog.english:
Leomon won't be the only one at
the Village of Beginnings...
dialog.translation:
Leomon no será el único en
la Aldea del Comienzo...

dialog.english:
All the Digimon who died for us
will be reborn...
dialog.translation:
Los Digimon muertos por
nosotros renacerán...

dialog.english:
Yeah! So let's go look for the
Village of Beginnings!
dialog.translation:
Sí! Vamos a buscar la
Aldea del Comienzo!

dialog.english:
The Village of Beginnings has
stopped functioning. All because
of the Dark Masters...
dialog.translation:
La Aldea del Comienzo ha
dejado de funcionar. Todo por
culpa de los Amos Oscuros...

dialog.english: All because of the Dark Masters...
dialog.translation:
Por culpa de los Amos
Oscuros...

dialog.english: All because of the Dark Masters...
dialog.translation:
Por culpa de los Amos
Oscuros...

dialog.english:
Until they've been defeated, the
Village of Beginnings won't go
back to normal.
dialog.translation:
Hasta que sean derrotados, la
Aldea del Comienzo no volverá
a la normalidad.

dialog.english: No way...

I don't wanna just sit around here
doing nothing...
dialog.translation:
No quiero quedarme aquí sin
hacer nada...

dialog.english:
Mimi, I know it's painful, but
defeating the Dark Masters is our
only choice left.
dialog.translation:
Mimi, sé que duele, pero
vencer a los Amos Oscuros
es nuestra única opción.

dialog.english:
Please, Mimi! Let me fight with
them!

If we don't fight, more of our
friends will die, so it's better
for us to fight!
dialog.translation:
Si no luchamos, morirán más
amigos nuestros, así que es
mejor que luchemos!

dialog.english:
Okay. I'll do whatever I can to
get the Village of Beginnings back
to normal.
dialog.translation:
Vale. Haré lo posible para
que la Aldea del Comienzo
vuelva a la normalidad.

dialog.english: Will you help us, Ogremon?
Kh. I don't feel like helping you!

But I still have a fight to settle
with Leomon, so I guess I don't
have a choice...
dialog.translation:
Pero aún tengo una pelea
pendiente con Leomon, así que
no tengo más remedio...

dialog.english:
Thanks. It's a relief to have you
here.
dialog.translation:
Gracias. Es un alivio
tenerte aquí.

dialog.english:
Okay, I've decided. Let's gather
some allies!
dialog.translation:
Vale, ya lo decidí. Reunamos
algunos aliados!

dialog.english: Allies?

We'll look for Digimon who are up
against the Dark Masters.
dialog.translation:
Buscaremos Digimon que luchen
contra los Amos Oscuros.

dialog.english: Yeah!
Princess, can we come with you?
You can't!
What? Nooooo!

But if you call me "Mimi" instead
of "Princess", I'll bring you
along!
dialog.translation:
Pero si me llamáis "Mimi" en
vez de "Princesa", os llevo
con nosotros!

dialog.english: Mimi! Take us with you, ribbit!
Of course!
